Main object around 40% canvas, small low-contrast near-black irregular support 52%, portions of boundary lost; no complete bright outer ring. Very light selective chalk edges, mostly quiet color planes. A few tiny broken fine traces near base only. No medal ribbons, laurel wreath, trophy, crown, jewel render, symmetrical emblem, glossy bevel, realistic fruit texture or dense granular material. Core silhouette clean and expressive, depth only through flat overlap, do not make a physical ornament. True transparent RGBA outer canvas, generous empty margins, no letters, words, border or poster. Output ONE node icon.
